description: Search HM Land Registry Price Paid Data — every residential property sale in England & Wales since 1995 — by exact UK postcode. Optional filters: min/max price paid (GBP), min/max transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD), and pagination. Returns price paid, transaction date, property type, estate type (freehold/leasehold), new-build flag, and full address for each sale. Data: HM Land Registry, no auth required, Open Government Licence v3.0.

max_date.description: Only include transactions completed on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

min_date.description: Only include transactions completed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

page_size.description: Number of transactions per page (1-100, default 20).

postcode.description: UK postcode to search (e.g. "SW1A 1AA"). Matches on exact postcode.

name: uk-landregistry-pricepaid.property.by_postcode

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: UK Property Sales By Postcode
